skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the concept of multimodal transport.
Analyze different modes of transportation used in multimodal transport.
Design and implement service models for multimodal transport.
Analyze costs associated with multimodal transport operations.
Develop pricing strategies for multimodal transport services.
Identify information needs for decision-making in multimodal transport management.
Manage group projects related to multimodal transport.
Resolve conflicts that arise during group work.
Analyze logistics operations within the context of multimodal transport.
Understand legal responsibilities of multimodal transport operators.
